scope: Fixed synthetic collectors plus real primary-agent shell invocation, continuation and browser freshness guard. Browser setup excluded and recorded separately. Two model lanes; each lane serial. Not unrestricted agent tool selection.

pricing.unit: USD per million tokens, standard short context
pricing.caveat: API-equivalent estimates, not a subscription invoice. Cache writes, promotions, regional surcharges and service tiers excluded; unknown usage is a lower bound.

measurement_notes: Two command events omitted aggregated_output in the Codex JSON stream. These character measurements are null, not zero; no values were imputed. Quality, latency and actual usage remain available.
Exact completion additionally requires needs_review=false; selection_correct is reported separately. Fewer reviews do not establish better calibration on unseen data.
